predictions.prediction_text: Within a trend, as prices approach the edges of the range, price movements will exhibit negative autocorrelation and are more likely to reverse.
predictions.expected_result: A counter-movement toward the trend center will occur shortly, measurable as a negative autocorrelation and a price move back inside the trend bounds.

predictions.prediction_text: Stocks with high past returns will continue to generate high returns in the near future (momentum effect).
predictions.expected_result: These stocks will outperform the broader market/index over the subsequent short-term period (higher cumulative and annualized returns vs benchmark).

predictions.prediction_text: Past stock returns are positively correlated with future returns over short horizons.
predictions.expected_result: Positive correlation will be observed such that periods with strong recent returns produce above-average subsequent short-term returns.

predictions.prediction_text: Past stock returns are negatively correlated with future returns over long horizons.
predictions.expected_result: Long-horizon reversals will occur where past winners underperform and past losers outperform over multi-year periods.

predictions.prediction_text: Stocks with the worst long-term past returns tend to outperform over the next 36 months while the best past performers underperform.
predictions.expected_result: A portfolio of prior 36-month “loser” stocks will outperform a portfolio of prior 36-month “winner” stocks over the following 36 months (e.g., ~19.6% relative outperformance as historically observed).

predictions.prediction_text: As price approaches the 1-sigma or 2-sigma rolling standard-deviation levels around a moving average, the probability of mean reversion increases.
predictions.expected_result: Price will revert toward the moving average and move back inside the 1-sigma (≈68.2%) or 2-sigma (≈95.45%) range within the measured timeframe.

predictions.prediction_text: Converting implied volatility to the chosen timeframe defines a price range around the previous close where the price is expected to remain with ~68.2% (1-sigma) or ~95.45% (2-sigma) probability.
predictions.expected_result: Over the specified period, the traded price will stay within the calculated 1-sigma or 2-sigma band at rates consistent with the stated probabilities.

predictions.prediction_text: Volatility cycles produce periods where over- or under-priced volatility attracts one-sided positioning that later reverts, hurting the overcrowded side.
predictions.expected_result: Crowded one-sided positions will be followed by sharp reversals and increased realized volatility that inflict losses on the previously dominant side.

predictions.prediction_text: Leveraged portfolios of low-beta stocks can produce higher risk-adjusted returns than unleveraged high-beta portfolios (beta anomaly).
predictions.condition: leveraging low-beta portfolio vs unleveraged high-beta portfolio
predictions.expected_result: A leveraged low-beta portfolio will achieve higher risk-adjusted returns (e.g., higher Sharpe ratio) than the unleveraged high-beta portfolio over the evaluation period.

predictions.prediction_text: Stocks with lower market capitalization tend to generate higher future returns than larger-cap stocks (size anomaly).
predictions.expected_result: Small-cap stocks will outperform large-cap stocks on an annualized return basis over the tested horizon.

predictions.prediction_text: Value-based cheap stocks will outperform expensive stocks in future returns (value anomaly).
predictions.condition: low P/B or low P/E (value metrics)
predictions.expected_result: Value-screened stocks will deliver higher subsequent returns than expensive peers over the measurement period.

predictions.prediction_text: Companies with higher asset growth tend to underperform in future returns compared to companies with lower asset growth (asset growth anomaly).
predictions.expected_result: High asset-growth companies will exhibit lower future returns than low asset-growth companies over the tested horizon.

predictions.prediction_text: A trend is likely to persist only if growth accelerates relative to prior data and momentum is strong enough to overcome distribution effects and dealer flows; otherwise momentum will fade.
predictions.condition: both: growth acceleration relative to prior data AND sufficient momentum to overcome distribution/dealer flows
predictions.expected_result: If both conditions hold the price will continue in the trend direction and break resistance levels; if either condition fails the trend will lose strength or reverse.

predictions.prediction_text: Larger deviations from a central location will induce a stronger reversion pull toward the center (Ornstein–Uhlenbeck–type mean reversion).
predictions.expected_result: Assets farther from their central mean will revert with greater speed or magnitude toward that mean than assets with smaller deviations.
